hooks.command: echo 'WARNING: /compact is BANNED in Rhodesli. Use /clear instead. /compact is lossy and causes instruction amnesia. This will be logged as a RED FLAG in session assessment.' >&2 && exit 0

echo 'PARALLELIZATION CHECK: Before starting, analyze this prompt for parallel opportunities. Independent phases (different files) can use worktree-isolated subagents. Max 3-4 worktrees. Merge: docs first, then code.'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"command\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "\bgit commit\b"; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && source venv/bin/activate && python -m pytest tests/ -x -q --ignore=tests/e2e/ 2>&1 | tail -5; fi'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"tool_input\",{}); print(d.get(\"file_path\",d.get(\"path\",\"\")))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "(rhodesli_ml|core)/.*\.py$"; then echo "REMINDER: Update ALGORITHMIC_DECISIONS.md if this changes ML behavior." >&2; fi'
